g.text: An evidence trail for agent actions
Connect each request to its decision, execution, and observed effect.
Source-to-destination redaction is applied before the modeled send.
Correlate records using run_id and request_id
Host-side artifacts outside the operations exposed by modeled tools
Solid: action / review flow · Dashed: evidence references
The published CLI checks event-chain consistency. Snapshot, lifecycle, outcome, and producer-trust checks are separate.
